messages:
mira: Heads-up — I just noticed a coverage gap for tonight's midnight rotation. I'm primary 00:00-08:00 but sylvia's calendar shows OOO from 02:00-03:30 and we currently have no confirmed secondary for that window. Can someone pick up the 02:00-03:30 chunk or confirm a planned fallback?

alex: I can take the 02:00-03:30 slice if needed. Quick Q: do we want to do a swap (i.e., alex becomes secondary for full night) or just a handoff note for that window?

sylvia: sorry, that OOO on calendar is accurate — short dentist appointment. I can be on slack while I'm gone but won't take pages. do the runbook escalate if page comes twice.

jonathan: I can cover as secondary from 01:30-04:00 if that helps — gives extra overlap. prefer swap so rollover is cleaner.

mira: thanks jonathan. Swap is fine. alex do you still prefer only 02:00-03:30 or you want to hand the full secondary slot to jonathan?

alex: i'm good with just 02:00-03:30; but if jonathan can take 01:30-04:00 that's cleaner. i'll DM opsbot to update rotation metadata.

opsbot: @alex noted — updating rotation metadata. Please confirm in thread once opsbot posts the new primary/secondary mapping.

mira: quick checklist for whoever is taking the secondary: 1) confirm you can receive phone-sms pages, 2) make sure mobile push is enabled, 3) review runbook link and recent alerts. runbook: https://internal.redwood.io/runbooks/oncall-handoff

jonathan: confirmed phone + push enabled. skimmed the runbook; main things to watch for tonight are inference QPS spikes (alerts: INF-QPS-5m) and KV cache degradation (KV-LATENCY).

mira: adding runbook snippet for easy reference:
```
If page comes: 
1) Acknowledge in Slack thread and pulse (pager) within 2 minutes.
2) Check model-serving cluster health: `kubectl get pods -n serving -o wide` and look for restarts.
3) If INF-QPS-5m > threshold: scale up dedicated pool via ops tooling or escalate to infra oncall.
4) If KV-LATENCY: clear prefix cache, check redis cluster metrics.
5) If customer impact suspected: create incident with severity tag and ping #incidents and #customer-success.
```

incident-bot: Reminder — Redwood Pager policy: if primary does not acknowledge within 2 minutes, escalate to secondary. If secondary does not acknowledge within 5 minutes, escalate to infra oncall. See policy: https://internal.redwood.io/policies/pager

alex: opsbot update posted — rotation now shows: mira primary 00:00-08:00, jonathan secondary 01:30-04:00, alex backup 02:00-03:30. sylvia marked as temporarily unavailable 02:00-03:30.

sylvia: thanks everyone, appreciate the cover. i'll be reachable by DM but won't take pager alerts.

mira: great — last asks before we close this thread: jonathan please confirm you'll take the first page if it arrives between 01:30-04:00. alex, stand by for any early handoff messages. i'll do a brief on-call notes ping at 23:50 with final checklist. :thumbsup:

jonathan: confirmed, i'll accept primary escalate during my secondary window and follow the runbook.

mira: thanks all — closing the handoff coordination. if anything changes ping here.
